thread:
maria: Quick sync: we need a final, tight slice for the Optimize recommendations deliverable (batching heuristics, prefix/KV caching guidance, quantization recommendation tiers, and eval-triggered alerts). Exec wants concrete launch gates.
leah: Proposal for MVP lanes: 1) adaptive batching heuristics (latency-budget aware), 2) prefix/KV caching defaults + suggested TTLs, 3) quant recommendation table (safe/int8, experimental/int4-awq), 4) eval-alert pipeline + runbook. Each lane ships independently.
ben: Measurable gates idea: econ >=12% token-cost reduction on our corpus OR memory saving that increases concurrent QPS; p99 latency delta <= +6%; quant-induced quality drop <= 1.5% on our concordance benchmark. Pilot customers: mediportal and shopify-lite.
maria: Also add per-route opt-in toggles and per-customer policy differences. We need explicit behavior for community vs paid customers.
leah: Customer tiers suggested: community = read-only recommendations; pro = recommendations + opt-in automation; enterprise = automated recommendations + auto-fallback + SLA.
ops-bot: FYI: canary window requested for dedicated cluster on 2026-04-15 08:00UTC. Will ping #eng-oncall at deploy start.
leah: Eval-alerts flow (high-level): scheduled eval -> compute metrics -> compare to baseline -> sliding-window breach counting -> severity -> action. Rule: breach_count >= 2 in 3 successive eval windows triggers automated action. Example rule snippet: ```yaml
name: concordance_drop
metric: concordance_v1
baseline_alias: baseline_20260401
window: daily
breach_count_window: 3
breach_thresholds:
  - name: warn
    delta_pct: 4
  - name: critical
    delta_pct: 10
actions:
  warn: notify(#product, #cust-success)
  critical: trigger-fallback: true; create-incident: true
```
ben: Telemetry fields we must emit for rollout and postmortems: batch_latency_ms, batch_size_hist, cache_hit_rate, kv_prefix_ttl_sec, quant_mode, model_variant, eval_run_id, cost_delta_pct, p99_latency_change, request_route_tag.
maria: Launch gate checklist (final): 1) bench econ pass, 2) p99 SLO pass per route, 3) telemetry + logging in prod, 4) eval-alert wiring + runbook (incl playbook for false positives), 5) 2 pilot customer signoffs. Also document rollback policy: default fallback TTL = 2h, auto-reassess after TTL, manual extension allowed.
leah: UI surface for recommendations will be deferred to post-GA. MVP must provide API/CLI hooks and a JSON recommendation payload for customers.
ben: I'll own telemetry ingestion and bench harness.
leah: I'll draft the PRD, runbook, and example alert configs.
maria: I'll coordinate pilot invites, customer acceptance criteria, and the exec slide.
ops-bot: Reminder: canary scheduled and alerting will fire to #eng-oncall on deploy.
